findings.claim: A bare mention of another trial’s identifier anywhere in shown text authorizes reliance on its unseen record. This bypasses A3 even when the quoted sentence supplies no information supporting the answer.
findings.guidance_basis: Handbook 8.2.3 requires circumstances supporting the probability judgement; seeing an identifier does not establish the contents of its record. A3 forbids reliance on unseen sources. [Handbook](https://www.cochrane.org/authors/handbooks-and-manuals/handbook/current/chapter-08)
findings.failing_test: Source=_reg('Related trial: NCT09999999. Randomisation details were omitted.'); 1.2=PY; quote='Randomisation details were omitted.'; rationale='ClinicalTrials.gov record NCT09999999 confirms randomisation details were concealed.' -> NI; currently PY.

findings.claim: The unconditional MEMORY filter rejects legitimate shown evidence before A3 checks its provenance. The rounds 16–25 decline leaves this defect unresolved: describing the shown source as a 'published report' is not reliance on memory.
findings.guidance_basis: Handbook 8.2.3 permits supported probability judgements and reserves NI for insufficient information without reasonable contextual inference. Freezing a lexical restriction does not justify an incorrect NI. [Handbook](https://www.cochrane.org/authors/handbooks-and-manuals/handbook/current/chapter-08)
findings.failing_test: Shown FT source contains 'central web-based randomisation'; 1.2=PY with that quote and rationale='The published report describes central web-based randomisation, supporting concealment.' -> PY; currently NI solely because of 'published report'.

findings.claim: The round-25 disclaimer fix applies to 'another record' but not explicit identifiers in the rationale. Naming an unavailable record in a disclaimer wrongly discards an otherwise supported contextual answer.
findings.guidance_basis: A3 excludes reliance on unseen documents, not disclaimers of access. Handbook 8.2.3 supports retaining a reasonable inference from the evidence actually available. [Handbook](https://www.cochrane.org/authors/handbooks-and-manuals/handbook/current/chapter-08)
findings.failing_test: Source=_reg('Allocation by central web-based randomisation.'); 1.2=PY; quote='central web-based randomisation'; rationale='Record NCT09999999 was unavailable, but central web-based randomisation supports concealment.' -> PY; currently NI.
